raw_text: Seeing this image of Modi and Xi shaking hands going around WhatsApp groups. Is this real? The G20 summit just happened but I don't remember seeing this in any official coverage. The handshake looks way too dramatic and posed. Also the fingers look weird if you zoom in. Anyone with better image analysis skills want to take a look? EDIT: Confirmed fake by BOOM. It's AI generated. No official source has this image. Classic case of AI-generated political imagery being spread via WhatsApp forwards.
